source_refs.note: Exercise 3.3, Question 12: book p. 89-90, 24 questions (integration by parts); answer key p. 301 (printed under 'Exercise 3.5')

blocks.explanation:
Denominator \(1 + \cos x\) ke saath seedha kuch nahi hota, lekin half-angle identity \(1 + \cos x = 2\cos^2\frac{x}{2}\) ise bohat aasaan bana deti hai.
Is ke baad integrand \(\frac{1}{2}x\sec^2\frac{x}{2}\) ban jata hai, yani algebraic \(\times\) trigonometric.
First \(x\), second \(\sec^2\frac{x}{2}\) jis ka integral \(2\tan\frac{x}{2}\) hai.
Plan: identity, parts, phir \(\int \tan\frac{x}{2}\,dx\).
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\int \frac{x}{1 + \cos x}\,dx\).
Maloom karna: indefinite integral.
Tareeqa: identity \(1 + \cos x = 2\cos^2\frac{x}{2}\); phir parts, \(x\) first aur \(\sec^2\frac{x}{2}\) second.

Half-angle identity
\[1 + \cos x = 2\cos^2\dfrac{x}{2}\]
\[\int \dfrac{x}{2\cos^2\frac{x}{2}}\,dx = \dfrac{1}{2}\int x\sec^2\dfrac{x}{2}\,dx\]
Kyun: \(\cos 2\theta = 2\cos^2\theta - 1\) mein \(\theta = \frac{x}{2}\) rakhein to \(\cos x = 2\cos^2\frac{x}{2} - 1\), yani \(1 + \cos x = 2\cos^2\frac{x}{2}\). Denominator ab ek hi term hai.

Parts lagayein
\[= \dfrac{1}{2}\left[x\cdot 2\tan\dfrac{x}{2} - \int 2\tan\dfrac{x}{2}\,dx\right]\]
\[= x\tan\dfrac{x}{2} - \int \tan\dfrac{x}{2}\,dx\]
Kyun: \(\sec^2\frac{x}{2}\) ka integral \(\frac{\tan\frac{x}{2}}{\frac{1}{2}} = 2\tan\frac{x}{2}\). Bahar wala \(\frac{1}{2}\) aur yeh 2 aapas mein cancel.
Dhyan dein: \(\frac{1}{2}\) se divide karna 2 se zarb dena hai; yahan \(\frac{1}{2}\tan\frac{x}{2}\) likhna ghalat hoga.

\(\tan\frac{x}{2}\) ka integral
\[\int \tan\dfrac{x}{2}\,dx = 2\ln\left|\sec\dfrac{x}{2}\right|\]
\[= x\tan\dfrac{x}{2} - 2\ln\left|\sec\dfrac{x}{2}\right| + c\]
Kyun: \(\int \tan kx\,dx = \frac{1}{k}\ln|\sec kx|\), yahan \(k = \frac{1}{2}\), to \(\frac{1}{k} = 2\).

Tasdeeq
\[\dfrac{d}{dx}(\ldots) = \tan\dfrac{x}{2} + \dfrac{x}{2}\sec^2\dfrac{x}{2} - \tan\dfrac{x}{2}\]
\[= \dfrac{x}{2\cos^2\frac{x}{2}} = \dfrac{x}{1 + \cos x}\]
Kyun: \(2\ln|\sec\frac{x}{2}|\) ka derivative \(2\cdot\frac{1}{2}\tan\frac{x}{2} = \tan\frac{x}{2}\). Cancel ke baad integrand wapas aaya.
